programme.title: Dva i pol muškarca
programme.desc: Charlie si stěžuje Chelsee, že Alanova přítelkyně Melissa dělá vše pro to, aby se k nim nastěhovala, ta si ale myslí, že by měl Alana víc podporovat. Melissa pak skutečně začne po Charliem chtít, aby tam mohla bydlet, chce si přivézt nějaký svůj nábytek. Charliemu nezbude než souhlasit. Soužití jde ale Charliemu pěkně na nervy, což vyvrcholí velkou párty, kterou Alan s Melissou pořádají v jeho domě. Skladatel hudby k reklamám Charlie žije spokojeně život svobodného mládence v komfortním domě přímo u pláže v Malibu, a právě když si užívá s jednou ze svých četných známostí, objeví se u něj jeho mladší bratr Alan, kterého vyhodila jeho žena Judith. Druhého dne přivede Alan i Judith, aby si mohli pohovořit, a svěří zatím Charliemu syna Jakea. Charlie po počátečních rozpacích vezme Jakea s sebou na nákupy a zjistí pro něj překvapivou věc, že muž s dítětem má pro dívky zvláštní přitažlivost.

programme.title: Dva i pol muškarca
programme.desc: Jake se přestěhuje zpět k Judith a Herbovi poté, co zjistí, že Alan má vztah s matkou jeho nejlepšího kamaráda. Alan se snaží situaci napravit, ale netuší, že ani Jake není tak úplně bez viny. Jake se přestěhuje zpět k Judith a Herbovi poté, co zjistí, že Alan má vztah s matkou jeho nejlepšího kamaráda. Alan se snaží situaci napravit, ale netuší, že ani Jake není tak úplně bez viny. Charlie se rozhodne omezit alkohol, ale jeho snaha není příliš úspěšná.

programme.title: Ubojstva u zgradi V
programme.desc: (Only Murders in the Building V) Troje stranaca koji dijele opsesiju pravim zločinima iznenada se nađu upleteni u jedan.

programme.title: Teorija velikog praska
programme.desc: Když Leonard a Penny vyplní dotazník pro indické manželství, netuší, co to mezi nimi způsobí. Rajesh se setkává s dívkou jménem Anu, kterou mu jeho otec dohodil jako budoucí ženu. Její přísná osobnost a ryze praktický přístup k manželství ho nejdříve odradí, ale pak se rozhodne, že do toho půjde, i když on je beznadějný romantik. Anu mu romantiku dopřeje, když ho v restauraci požádá o ruku. Rajesh nadšeně souhlasí. Na základě dotazníku pro indické manželství od Rajeshe se Leonard s Penny zatím dozvídají, že se v mnoha věcech neshodnou. A to zejména v otázce, zda chtějí děti. Penny je... striktně odmítá, čímž raní Leonarda, který s nimi do budoucna počítal. Nakonec se s tím smíří, prot ože mu život podle jeho slov dopřál řadu jiných skvělých věcí, se kterými nepočítal. Penny mu pak jako dárek na jeden den pronajme Batmobil, což bylo vždy jeho snem.

programme.title: Tragač
programme.desc: Seriál Tracker vypráví příběh o 218 nebezpečných zločincích, kteří uprchli z vězenské planety kdesi ve vesmíru. Skupinku vede Zin, nejmenší a nejkrutější z nich. Vymyslel jakousi červí díru, jak všechny transportovat do Chicaga. Město je nyní zamořeno všemožným kriminálním odpadem, cizinci, kteří se mohou proměnit v jakoukoliv formu života, mající mimořádné schopnosti: nadměrnou inteligenci, sílu a rychlost. Jediný kdo je může zastavit je Daggon (The Tracker), mimozemštan z planety Cirron.... Bere na sebe podobu člověka pod skrytou identitou jménem Cole. Jeho úkol je jasný, všechny pochytit, živé či mrtvé. Potkává Mel Porterovou, majitelku jedné hospody nedaleko místa Trackerových operací. Spolu tak utvoří vyjímečný pár, a budou čelit mnohonásobné přesile nezvaných návštěvníků.

programme.title: Anna Herman (9,10)
programme.desc: Drama. Annu Herman nazyvaly "Bilyj anhel polskoji estrady", jiji zapysuvaly, sluxaly, bohotvoryly. Žyttja cijeji žinky - ce istorija podolannja. Ukrajina, 2012-2012. Režyser: Artem Antonov. U roljax: Joanna Moro.

programme.title: Maestro (1-4)
programme.desc: Drama. 1986 rik, Odesa. Na šljaxu ščastja dvox zakoxanyx Paši ta Lili vstaje batko divčyny. Budučy vplyvovoju i považnoju v misti ljudynoju, vin vidmovljajetsja daty dozvil na vesillja z bidnym xlopcem bez vyznačenoho majbutnoho. Batko Lili stavyt umovu, ščo dlja počatku Paši neobxidno zarobyty hrošej na pokupku kooperatyvnoji kvartyry. Dlja coho xlopec vlaštovujetsja motorystom na torhove sudno. Vin povertajetsja do Odesy čerez 8 misjaciv pislja služby na comu korabli. Paša prahne... nadolužyty zhajane, adže za poklykannjam moloda ljudyna - muzykant. Vin stvorjuje hurt "Bez B", ščo vykonuje zavzjati pisni v styli rok-n-rol. Hlava Lilinoji sim'ji, jak i raniše, nalaštovanyj skeptyčno i ne vvažaje joho hidnym ruky svojeji dočky. Ale nezabarom u žytti Paši z'javljajetsja šče odna problema. Vin zustričaje pryvablyvu aferystku Leru. Z jiji pojavoju v joho žyttja pryxodjat spravžnij azart i nebezpečni pryhody. Paši naležyt zrobyty skladnyj vybir miž jaskravym i nasyčenym svitom Lery, jakyj tak nahaduje joho uljublenyj rok-n-rol, i koxanoju Lileju ... Ukrajina, 2016. Režyser: Eduard Parri. U roljax: Leonid Teležynskyj, Mykola.

Vin stvorjuje hurt "Bez B", ščo vykonuje zavzjati pisni v styli rok-n-rol. Hlava Lilinoji sim'ji, jak i raniše, nalaštovanyj skeptyčno i ne vvažaje joho hidnym ruky svojeji dočky. Ale nezabarom u žytti Paši z'javljajetsja šče odna problema. Vin zustričaje pryvablyvu aferystku Leru. Z jiji pojavoju v joho žyttja pryxodjat spravžnij azart i nebezpečni pryhody. Paši naležyt zrobyty skladnyj vybir miž jaskravym i nasyčenym svitom Lery, jakyj tak nahaduje joho uljublenyj rok-n-rol, i koxanoju Lileju ... Ukrajina, 2016. Režyser: Eduard Parri. U roljax: Leonid Teležynskyj, Mykola.

programme.title: Navy CIS
programme.desc: Seriál vypráví o každodenní práci týmu speciálních agentů pod vedením zkušeného vyšetřovatele Leroye Jethro Gibbse, který musí vyřešit jakýkoliv zločin týkající se zaměstnanců vojenských námořních sil. Tým zvláštních agentů, kteří operují mimo vojenské velení, musí vyšetřit každý zločin, který má něco společného s námořními silami, bez ohledu na to, jakou hodnost mají podezřelí. Vede je zvláštní agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs, který vedle racionálních úvah vždy dá i na své instinkty.

programme.title: Rosewood
programme.desc: Doktor Rosewood je soukromým poradcem v oboru patologie, přestože o to detektivové většinou nestojí, tak jim pomáhá řešit případy vražd v Miami. Tentokrát ho matka požádá o prohlédnutí její mrtvé studentky, o které si je jistá, že nezemřela při autonehodě. Doktor Rosewood je soukromým poradcem v oboru patologie. Ve své profesi je tím nejlepším v Miami. Má svou moderní laboratoř, ve které pracuje jeho sestra Pippy se svou snoubenkou Tarou. Rosewood má vrozenou vadu v srdci, a tak potřebuje ke svému životu brát neustále léky. Přestože o to detektivové většinou nestojí, tak jim pomáhá řešit případy vražd v Miami.

programme.title: Rosewood
programme.desc: Tajomná smrť slávneho muža vo výťahu prázdneho mrakodrapu je nový rébus pre Rosieho s Villovou. Obeťou je bývalá detská hviezda, ktorá plánovala návrat na výslnie. Rosie prehlbuje svoj vzťah k Donne.

programme.title: Ubojstva na dobrom brodu II
programme.desc: (The Good Ship Murder II). Na luksuznom brodu za krstarenje koji obilazi Sabina svima omiljena odredišta za odmor na Mediteranu, novi kabaretski pjevač Jack Grayling otkriva zlokobne elemente. Na krstarenju iz Southamptona, Jack upoznaje tek unaprijeđenu prvu časnicu, Kate Woods. Nakon što je putnik pronađen ubijen u prvoj luci, Katein san o vlastitoj komandi je ugrožen a Jack se vraća u prijašnji život detektiva.

programme.title: Sherlock i Watson
programme.desc: Sherlock je varován, že mu hrozí smrt. Jeho bývalí kolegové již zemřeli a vždy to vypadalo jako náhoda.

programme.title: Sherlock i Watson
programme.desc: Joan a Kitty se snaží dokázat, že řada vražd, které mají původ ve starém případu, který Sherlock a Kitty řešili v Londýně, souvisí s mezinárodním vládním spiknutím, v jehož centru stojí vojenská zpravodajská služba.

programme.title: Misterije u jutarnjem programu: Dizajnerska smrt
VIP: Visoki intelektualni potencijal I
programme.desc: (HPI : Haut Potentiel Intellectuel I) Radeći kao čistačica u postaji, Morgane je ""počistila" ploču za istrage. Idući dan policajci uviđaju da im je pomogla naći sumnjivca. Morgane ima visoki intelektualni potencijal. Njezin je kvocijent inteligencije 160, ali to joj ne pomaže u životu.

programme.title: Ubojstva na dobrom brodu
programme.desc: Former police detective Jack Grayling, now pursuing his dream of becoming a cabaret singer on a luxury Mediterranean cruise ship, investigates a series of murders on board with the help of ship's First Officer Kate Woods.

programme.title: Zločinački umovi: Evolucija
programme.desc: V seriálu Myšlenky zločince se elitní tým analytiků FBI zabývá sestavováním osobnostních profilů sériových vrahů. Snaží se proniknout do jejich temné a komplikované mysli, aby předešli dalším vražedným útokům. Jakmile se ukáže, že kriminální případ by se mohl týkat masového vraha, FBI se ihned obrátí na jednotku Behavioral Analysis Unit v Quanticu. Zatímco řadoví detektivové při vyšetřování zločinu hledají důkazy a usvědčující materiály, tento tým zkoumá způsob chování a myšlení zločinců, aby se zúžil počet podezřelých. Velitelem týmu je zvláštní agent Jason Gideon, špičkový analytik FBI. Mezi jeho spolupracovníky patří:zvláštní agent Aaron Hotchner se smyslem pro rodinu, který dokáže z lidí... dostat pravdu a odhalit jejich tajemství, zvláštní agent dr. Spencer Reid, nepochopený génius, jehož soci ální IQ je tak nízké jak vysoké je jeho IQ intelektuální; zvláštní agent Derek Morgan, expert na zločiny z posedlosti, a agentka Elle Greenwayová. Ta se věnuje sexuálním zločinům a její motivací je nevyřešené znásilnění, které sama před lety prožila.

programme.title: CSI: New York
programme.desc: Detektiv Mack Mac Taylor (Gary Sinise) věří, že všechno spolu nějak souvisí a že každý má svůj skrytý příběh. On i jeho parťačka Stella Bonasera (Melina Kanakaredesová) jsou svou prací doslova posedlí, a díky tomu stojí v čele týmu expertů ve velkoměstě, které nikdy nespí. Do týmu dále patří Danny Messer (Carmine Giovinazzo), který se narodil v Brooklynu, nic ho nerozhází a vždy má po ruce nějakou tu historku o příbuzenstvu, a uzavřený doktor Sheldon Hawkes (Hill Harper), který se po... traumatizující smrti dvou pacientů vzdal dráhy chirurga a pracuje jako koroner. Dvojici doplňuje popudlivý detektiv Don Flack (Eddie Cahill), inteligentní muž s pozoruhodným instinktem a nedostatkem trpělivosti pro potenciální podezřelé. Mimo tým pak stojí bystrá a půvabná vyšetřovatelka Aiden Burnová (Vanessa Ferlitová), která se dokáže přizpůsobit jakékoliv situaci. Detektivové v New Yorku mají možná jiné problémy než jejich kolegové v Miami či Las Vegas, ale vede je stejně neochvějné odhodlání bránit šíření zločinu. Tito schopní lidé znají New York v jiném světle než jeho ostatní obyvatelé a hledají důkazy, které se postupně skládají v celek, a nakonec poskytnou klíč k rozluštění složitých případů, jež tým řeší.

programme.title: Sherlock i Watson
programme.desc: Místo: New York City, USA. Hrdinové: Sherlock Holmes a Joan Watson. Problém: Žijí spolu. Sherlock přivádí Joan k šílenství, a přesto spolu dokáží řešit ty nejzapeklitější případy, ke kterým se díky asistenci policie dostávají. Sherlock původně cestuje do New Yorku proto, aby se zbavil své závislosti na alkoholu, nakonec však skončí jako spolubydlící Joan Watsonové, která přišla o lékařskou licenci kvůli úmrtí pacienta. Jak dopadne toto nové a velmi netradiční zpracování příběhů sira A. C.... Doylea.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Lasvegaská kriminalistická divize je druhá kriminální laboratoř v USA. Řeší případy, které by každé jiné oddělení vzdalo. Vedená umíněným kapitánem Jimem Brassem a svérázným Gilem Grissomem pátrá po zločincích za pomoci nejnovějších vědeckých analýz. CSI vypráví o méně viditelných hrdinech policejní práce, soudních vyšetřovatelích. Jsou to lidé, kteří se za žlutou policejní páskou snaží rozluštit zdánlivě neřešitelné případy. Vedle dopadení pachatele mají ještě jeden a možná důležitější úkol. Musí se postarat o maximální ochranu těch, kteří se stali obětí trestného činu.

programme.title: CSI: New York
programme.desc: Když v prestižní soukromé taneční škole zavraždí zástupce, starosta dá příkaz, aby Mac a jeho tým co nejrychleji našli pachatele. Maca to frustruje, protože se nemohou věnovat případu "Vraha z taxíků".. Tým CSI přivolají do snobské soukromé taneční školy, kde našli tělo jejího zástupce s jakoby rozpuštěnou tváří. Starosta trvá na tom, aby tým zaměřil všechny síly na rychlé odhalení pachatele. Když tým odhalí pachatele - jedno z dětí, které se zúčastňovalo tanečních hodin - přijdou k jednomu zmatenému zjištění. Mladistvě vypadající pachatel nemá osmnáct, ale je to třicátník. Horší je, že muž spolupracoval s jiným predátorem, který láká nic netušící studenty do svého brlohu. Mac není spokojený, protože nemůže chytit taxikářského vraha dříve, než znova udeří..

programme.title: CSI: New York
programme.desc: Detektiv Mack Mac Taylor (Gary Sinise) věří, že všechno spolu nějak souvisí a že každý má svůj skrytý příběh. On i jeho parťačka Stella Bonasera (Melina Kanakaredesová) jsou svou prací doslova posedlí, a díky tomu stojí v čele týmu expertů ve velkoměstě, které nikdy nespí. Do týmu dále patří Danny Messer (Carmine Giovinazzo), který se narodil v Brooklynu, nic ho nerozhází a vždy má po ruce nějakou tu historku o příbuzenstvu, a uzavřený doktor Sheldon Hawkes (Hill Harper), který se po... traumatizující smrti dvou pacientů vzdal dráhy chirurga a pracuje jako koroner. Dvojici doplňuje popudlivý detektiv Don Flack (Eddie Cahill), inteligentní muž s pozoruhodným instinktem a nedostatkem trpělivosti pro potenciální podezřelé. Mimo tým pak stojí bystrá a půvabná vyšetřovatelka Aiden Burnová (Vanessa Ferlitová), která se dokáže přizpůsobit jakékoliv situaci. Detektivové v New Yorku mají možná jiné problémy než jejich kolegové v Miami či Las Vegas, ale vede je stejně neochvějné odhodlání bránit šíření zločinu. Tito schopní lidé znají New York v jiném světle než jeho ostatní obyvatelé a hledají důkazy, které se postupně skládají v celek, a nakonec poskytnou klíč k rozluštění složitých případů, jež tým řeší.

programme.title: Svi vole Raymonda
programme.desc: Sportovní novinář Ray Baron a jeho žena Debra by si žili normálním spokojeným životem, nebýt faktu, že dům naproti přes ulici obývají Rayovi rodiče a jeho bratr Robert. Sportovní novinář Ray Baron a jeho žena Debra by si žili normálním spokojeným životem, nebýt faktu, že dům naproti přes ulici obývají Rayovi rodiče Marie a Frank a bratr Robert. Pletou se jim úplně do všeho - do výchovy dětí, soukromých manželských rozepří nebo třeba výběru dovolené. Zatímco Ray se snaží neztratit hlavu a všechno to trpí, Debra se co chvíli zmůže na odpor, aby vzápětí stejně pochopila, že to nikam nevede, a znovu a znovu zatínala zuby nad Baronovic neomaleností.

programme.title: Vampirski dnevnici
programme.desc: Caroline, Matt, Jeremy and Bonnie party at a bar as Elena dances on the bar and strips to a tank top when Matt shouts at her to take it off. Someone hands her a shot and as she's about to down it, she stops and hops down, confronting her friends, not able to believe that they can't tell she's not herself. The real Elena would never dance on a bar and do shots with her underage brother, she tells them, explaining that she's not herself -- she's Katherine.Elena wakes up in her dorm room. The... whole house is empty. She's goes downstairs and finds Stefan there. He tells her everyone's gone on s pring break and she's been in an out. They sealed her in with a spell.The last thing she remembers is running through the woods, feeling like she was being attacked by Katherine's whole life, then throwing her arms around Damon. That was three weeks ago.She knows Katherine infected her with the Augustine virus. Bonnie's new witch friend Liv sealed Elena in. Caroline is out looking for an antidote and they're rationing blood to keep her satiated. She wants to talk to Damon.But he's currently locked up in his cellar. Jeremy and Matt bring him vampire blood. Elena doesn't know Damon killed Aaron Whitmore, and Damon insists he be the one to tell her. Elena calls and they bring Damon his phone.She's calling from a payphone because Katherine put a passcode on her phone and she can't use it. She's freaked out by not knowing what happened the last three weeks. She asks him how Katherine broke his heart. He shrugs it off like he doesn't remember."The last thing I remember I was running into your arms and I felt so safe," she says. "It was all downhill from there," he says. "I wanted to fight for you, I still do.""The second we are cured of this and don't want to rip each other's heads off, I am going to hunt you down and give you the most mind-blowing night of your life," Damon says.Meanwhile, in Wes Maxfield's lab, Caroline finds Wes's recorder and hears him saying that he added the werewolf venom to the virus to make it even stronger.Enzo strolls in. Caroline isn't happy to see bad Damon's killing buddy, but he tells her he has the antidote.On the phone, Elena realizes she's probably flunking her classes, and adds that to the list of things she needs to fix, including talking to Aaron Whitmore. The last time she saw him he had just learned she was a vampire and thought she wanted to kill him. Damon hems and haws and doesn't confess to killing him, only saying he doesn't think she'll find him.Elena gets off the phone when Stefan arrives with a new cell phone for her, and 4 oz. of his blood. She's woozy and starving and drains it. She asks for more, insisting she's fine.Stefan bites his wrist and shows it to her and she quickly loses control and charges him, but is trapped by the spell. "You're not fine, Elena," he says.Elena realizes Katherine has turned her into a ripper. She's angry at herself for forgiving Katherine on her supposed death bed.Caroline calls with an update: werewolf venom in the virus means it's fatal. But she says she has antidote if Stefan will go meet her. The Travelers don't want Liv the new witch to know about it, so he has to go to her.Elena asks Stefan why Katherine stayed in town, and he confesses that Katherine was trying to get with him. He tells Elena they kissed, but he stopped it and realized what was going on.At the bar, Liv is jazzed about being able to seal Elena in. Bonnie tries to get her to stop bragging then challenges her to a fire spell, but she can't do it.With her new phone, Elena leaves Aaron a message. Then she reads Katherine's entries in her diary, including her ploy to get near Stefan.Elena "remembers" Katherine spilling oil on her and stripping in front of Stefan and coming on to him. He starts kissing him passionately then pulls away, asking why he can't tell she's not herself. After everything they've been through, she wouldn't lead him on like that. Elena goes to leave and Damon is at the motel room door. He mocks Stefan for falling for the grease-on-my-shirt ploy. Elena tells them both to stop and tells them that even dead, Katherine is ruining their lives. "You think this is bad? You have no idea, do you?" Stefan says.Back reading the diary, Elena's nose starts bleeding.Enzo leads Stefan and Caroline to an abandoned rail yard to meet with Sloane and the Travelers -- Stefan already met some of them when they took a bucket of his blood. Enzo tells them how he was trapped in a farm house with ripper Damon when Wes and the Travelers let him go on the condition he help them.Wes needed a vampire to experiment on, so Enzo let him in order to make an antidote. The Travelers are using Wes's work to make an antidote to the version Elena has because she's valuable to them. But they need something. "Another one of you," Sloane tells Stefan.Elena talks to Damon and asks him to distract her. Damon tells her about Caroline and Klaus and that Katherine told Tyler.Elena gets a coughing fit and coughs up blood.Elena asks why they don't just hunt down Wes for the antidote and Damon tells her he killed Wes. She points out Wes was the only family that Aaron has, but then Damon is spared telling her he killed Aaron when Matt comes in for Damon's feeding.Enzo explains that the Travelers think the last remaining dopplegangers -- Stefan and Elena- are special. But until Stefan's other doppelganger is found, his blood mixed with Elena's won't do anything. Stefan reminds them the last time a witch (Amara) linked him to his doppelganger, she fried his brain and he lost his memory.Alone in her dorm, Elena gets woozy and starts hallucinating again. She sees Aaron Whitmore and sees that his room is empty. Then she sees his bloody neck. "Are you dead? Did I do this to you?" she says.Elena is snapped out of her hallucination when a guy named Luke comes back early from spring break. She met him at the Bitter Ball as Katherine, but of course doesn't remember him. He thinks she's drunk. She tells him she's just starving. She compels him, feeds him her blood and is about to kill him to turn him when she notices bite marks on his neck and realizes Katherine must have been feeding on him. She stops and compels him to go get Bonnie.Elena calls Damon in a panic, she can't tell what's real anymore. She tells Damon she thinks she killed Aaron. Damon promises to tell her everything, but says now isn't a good time. She freaks out, yelling that everyone is lying to her. She throws the phone. Damon yells for Matt, asking him to charge his phone.Instead, he grabs Matt, yanks off his ring and calls in Jeremy -- demanding to see Elena.Caroline and Stefan discuss the Traveler's plans. He agrees to be linked to his doppelganger. The Travelers give the antidotes to Enzo to deliver and Caroline stays with Stefan.Sloane slices Stefan's hand for the spell. The Travelers begin chanting and Stefan screams.Back in the dorm, Elena is losing her mind, she's ripping up books and throwing them on the fire. Bonnie and Liv arrive. Elena announces she's cleansing herself of everything Katherine ever touched.Bonnie tells her she's not herself, and Elena yells about that being ironic because she wasn't herself for weeks and nobody noticed. Bonnie tries to reason with her, that Katherine was trying to destroy her and this is what she wants. Elena pretends to be swayed, but grabs a piece of wood and throws it javelin-style at Liv, skewering her.She points out Liv will need her blood to survive, so she should drop the seal.Back at the rail yard, night has fallen and the Travelers are still chanting their spell. Finally, Sloane can see Stefan's doppelganger. He's a paramedic in Atlanta.Caroline urges them to stop, but Sloane wants more information, saying she needs the doppelganger dead. Caroline has had enough and puts a knife to Sloane's throat, telling her there's a way they can all get what they want.Elena wanders outside her dorm, still coughing up blood and hallucinating. She sees Aaron and thinks it means he's OK, but it's really Damon.Damon gives her Stefan's blood to drink."She won, Katherine won," Elena said. She rants about nearly killing Liv and killing Aaron Whitmore. Finally, Damon tells her she didn't kill Aaron -- he did.Damon tells her he killed Aaron the night he thought she broke up with him and to prove to himself that he was the type of person who could kill in cold blood and he was never going to change.He waits for her to say something, but she sees Enzo there -- with the antidotes.When Stefan wakes up from his Traveler mind probe Caroline tells him she and Enzo are going to Atlanta to kill his doppelganger, which she volunteered to do so they'd stop frying Stefan's brain. Stefan warns her not to trust Enzo.Bonnie walks Liv back to her dorm. Liv is not fazed by being attacked by Elena and is ready for more witch lessons.When Bonnie leaves, Liv walks into her room alone and lights all her candles easily with magic. Luke, who turns out to be her (gay) brother, is waiting for her.He faked being compelled by Elena. They know Bonnie is the anchor and are letting her think she's teaching Liv magic. Luke says it's only cute until she realizes her friends are in jeopardy.Elena finally talks to Damon, telling him he should have noticed she was Katherine. If he had, Aaron would still be alive, there'd be no virus. Damon points out she's blaming Katherine for his mistakes and making excuses for him.They start yelling, with her noting he's forcing her to compromise her morals again to make excuses for him. He calls their relationship toxic and they agree they shouldn't be together. He tells her to stop loving him, but she yells that she can't. She says it's over.That lasts for three seconds, and then they tear each other's clothes off and get in bed. Přátelé drží Elenu a Damona v izolaci. Hrozí, že by napadli buď sami sebe navzájem, nebo jiného upíra. Objeví se Enzo a ve spolupráci s poutníky nabídne Stefanovi a Caroline získání protijedu. Stefan a Caroline podstoupí rituální kouzlení za účelem nalezení Stefanova dvojníka výměnou za protijed. Bonnie netuší, že kouzelnice Liv společně se svým bratrem Lukem pracují proti upírům.

programme.title: Vampirski dnevnici
programme.desc: Sloane uses her Traveler mind meld to find Stefan's paramedic doppelganger Tom Avery at Atlanta Metropolitan Hospital. They see Tom refusing to wait for a doctor and performing a procedure to save a woman's life.Meanwhile, at casa de Salvatore, Elena wakes up in bed with Damon. Her phone buzzes to remind her to go to Jeremy's parent-teacher conference.When Damon wakes up, Elena says they're still bad for each other and still broken up and last night was a mistake."Maybe we should keep making... mistakes," Damon says. She leaves, despite his offer of a naked breakfast.At a diner in Atla nta, Enzo picks up Sloane's call to Caroline to give them more information. Back at Traveler HQ, they're carrying Stefan away on a stretcher. He's passes out. Caroline is angry that Sloane "dopplebombed" him again and threatens to kill her too if she does it again."Like a perky blonde Angel of Death, almost had me convinced," Enzo says.Damon heads to the Grill to drown his morning sorrow in booze. He complains to Tyler and Matt about Elena and mentions that Caroline is off doing something with Stefan, although he taunts Tyler by assuring him they're just friends.Liv, Bonnie's training witch (but not really), walks over to the bar and buys a bottle of gin. After rebuffing Damon, he sees her sit down at a table with Jeremy.Meanwhile, Elena calls Bonnie from school. She tells her about breaking up with Damon, then sleeping with him. They realize that neither of them knows where Jeremy was last night.Elena sits down to talk to Jeremy's guidance counselor and finds she's not his primary contact -- Damon is. Damon joins them.At the hospital in Atlanta, Caroline is cool to Enzo. He finally asks if she's avoiding the mission or him. "Why can't it be both?" she asks.When she questions why he's along on the trip, he jokes with Damon trying to do right he needs a new "murder buddy."She makes sure she's not the reason he's there. "Why not? From what Damon tells me, I am your type. Well-traveled, charming accent, dodgy morals..." Ezno says. "Arrogant, tactless, completely unable to take a hint," Caroline finishes. "Precisely," Enzo says. Then he tells her she reminds him of Maggie, a woman who worked with the Augustines, and observed him.The doctor they've been waiting for joins them and tells them Tom Avery disappeared four months ago.Stefan wakes up and realizes the Travelers have moved him to a junk yard outside Mystic Falls. They're waiting to meet Markos.Caroline calls with news that Tom is MIA. Sloan starts back up with the Traveler mind meld and Caroline worries they're frying Stefan's brain.Stefan sees a red-haired woman named Hazel asking Tom out after he saved her friend's life. She gives him an address. Stefan tells Caroline that Tom is a good person and not to go through with it.Waiting for the teacher at school, Damon flirts with Elena, who tries to keep him on task. Damon mentions seeing Jeremy with Liv and a bottle of booze this morning at the Grill. Elena is sure Jeremy's not a cheater.Then the teacher comes in: "Jeremy's missed 11 days of school, he's started three fights and he's been caught cheating in math class twice."She tells them Jeremy needs a stable living situation.At Hazel's address, they open the door and find Hazel performing a spell. When they can't get in, Enzo throws the doorknob at her head, killing her.Bonnie studies at Whitmore and sees Lucas nearby, continually looking at her. Suddenly, Hazel appears. She recognizes Bonnie as the anchor and tells her to tell Lucas she failed in hiding the doppelganger.At the Grill, Liv uses a spell to keep Tyler from listening as she talks to Jeremy. As a hunter, he can't be mind-controlled by Travelers, so he's the only one she trusts. She tells him the Travelers are up to something and they're on their way to Mystic Falls."Turns out Elena's friends are right -- the world does revolve around her," Liv says. She wants his help figuring out what the Travelers are up to. Then she gets a text from Lucas about Hazel, calling for Plan B.She tells Jeremy never mind, he was Plan A. Tyler zooms over to get answers and she uses magic to fling him backward, also informing them she's not a newbie witch.At school, Damon points out that Elena is making excuses for Jeremy, just like she always does with people she loves. She thinks he wants to talk about last night. He admits he doesn't know what to say, but just wants to take her into one of the classrooms and kiss every square inch of her body while people who drive minivans listen and wish they were them. She's tempted.Back in Atlanta, Enzo tries to prepare Caroline for having to kill Tom. He doesn't think she's up for it. She's insisting she is to save Stefan when they both hear a beating heart.They find Tom Avery drugged on a stretcher in the basement. Caroline realizes four months ago was when Silas, "the original Stefan-ganger" died.Enzo offers to kill Tom for Caroline, but she insists on doing it her way. When Tom wakes up, she compels him to trust her. Then she snaps Enzo's neck and tells Tom she's getting him out of there.Back at Whitmore, Bonnie learns Lucas is Liv's twin brother and a witch. She's creeped out they were watching her.Jeremy calls Bonnie asking where Elena is. He briefly tells her what Liv said about Elena and the Travelers. When Bonnie gets off the phone, Lucas is gone.At school, Elena drags Damon into a classroom and starts to rip his clothes off. Then the chemistry teacher's droning snaps her out of her daydream. She gets up to get air.Liv finds Elena in shop class. She flings Elena against the wall and prepares to stake her. "Sorry about this, the coven did everything in its power to protect you, but you're just too dangerous now," Liv says.She's about to drive the stake home when Damon finds Liv and knocks her out.Meanwhile, at the diner in Atlanta, Tom Avery tells Caroline his life story. She wants to make sure he's as good as he seems. Then he starts choking. Caroline doesn't help, and moves his water away.Then she's snapped out her daydream and goes back to watching Tom eating hungrily for the first time in four months. She compels Tom to get on a train and start a new life somewhere.Back at the high school, Damon tortures Liv for information. Elena points out that things like this are the reason they broke up.Finally, Liv tells them that Elena is the last female doppelganger and that Stefan might soon be the last male and if that happens, the Travelers will come to use Elena.Damon is ready to kill Liv, but Jeremy shows up and says Damon will have to go through him.Out in the parking lot, Tyler and Matt confront Lucas. Tyler grabs him before he can use magic on them.In the shop, Jeremy tries to convince Elena and Damon that Liv will help them keep Elena safe. Elena questions his trustworthiness considering all the stuff he's been pulling in school. "How can you expect me to care about school when this is my life?" Jeremy asks.He tells them Liv knows more about the Travelers than she's letting on.Elena tells Damon to trust Jeremy. Outside, Liv yells at her brother for not coming to help her. Jeremy tells them both his Plan C is for them to protect Elena while he helps them stop the Travelers. But he needs help -- Matt and Tyler.Caroline walks Tom to his car when Enzo appears. Before Caroline can stop him, Enzo snaps Tom's neck. He also made a deal -- the Travelers told him they know where to find his old flame Maggie.Back at the Salvatore house, Elena tells Damon she thinks they're bad for Jeremy. Then Jeremy joins them, suitcase in hand. He's going to stay with Tyler and Matt.Caroline returns to the Traveler junk yard and tells Stefan she's a big fat failure. "You do realize you're feeling guilty for not being able to kill somebody?" Stefan says.She tells him Enzo killed Tom.Stefan teases her for being out all day flirting with yet another British man while he was having his brain fried. But he suggests they sleep, and then figure out how to get out of there together.Caroline realizes that Stefan knew she wouldn't kill Tom. "Because that's what makes you you," he says.At the Salvatore house, Elena packs to go back to campus. "It's not just that we're bad for each other, it's that when we're together we do bad things for each other and I can't live like that," Elena says.She declines his offer of a ride, saying she needs him to let her go. He kisses her on the forehead and wishes her safe travels.Bonnie leaves Jeremy a message wanting to know what's going on. Stefan and Caroline wake up spooning in a car in the junkyard, hearing Traveler chanting.They see the Travelers drinking his blood and Elena's and chanting about Markos. Sloane takes a torch and lights a Traveler on fire and they all burst into flame.Stefan takes Caroline's hand and they run.At Whitmore, the dead Travelers appear around Bonnie chanting and pass through her one at a time, making her scream in pain. She passes out. Then a spirit of a man rises from her and walks away. Caroline a Enzo hledají v Atlantě pro poutníky Stefanova dvojníka, Toma, jak po nich chtěla výměnou za Stefanův život vůdce poutníků Sloan. Čarodějka Liv se pokusí zaútočit na Elenu a zabít ji. Naštěstí zasáhne Damon a Elenu ochrání. Liv se přizná, že to dělá proto, že čarodějky nechtějí, aby se Eleny zmocnili poutníci. Jeremy slíbí, že tomu zabrání. Caroline a Enzo Toma najdou, ale Caroline není schopná Toma zabít, a dokonce se ho pokusí ochránit. Tomu zabrání ale Enzo. Enzo Toma zabije ve... chvilce, kdy to Elena nečeká. Caroline se vrací ke Stefanovi do ležení poutníků. Ti se následně před jejich očima upálí. Ve chvíli, kdy mrtví poutníci procházejí přes Bonnie do záhrobí, z jejího těla vyjde tajemná postava.

programme.title: Miris žene
programme.desc: V New Yorku probíhají oslavy Dne díkuvzdání a bývalý důstojník Frank Slade si chce ještě užít alespoň trochu ze života: krásné ženy, dobré jídlo, limuzíny se šoférem a pokoj v hotelu Waldorf-Astoria. A mladý student Charlie Simms ho - ze začátku trochu neochotně -doprovází, aby tím získal velkou školu života. Slade je vskutku zajímavou osobností: bývalý poradce Lyndona Johnsona, nyní slepý, velmi zahořklý, avšak s duší básníka. Charlie je mladičký student řešící své životní kotrmelce. Jejich... společné hořce veselé dobrodružství je má oba navždy změnit. Slepota změnila plukovníka Franka Sladea v zatrpknutého, osamělého a cynického člověka, kterému se už nechce žít. Než se rozhodne definitivně skončit se svým životem, chce se ještě jednou pořádně pobavit. Spolu se studentem Charliem, kterého mu Sladeova rodina najala jako opatrovníka, odchází do New Yorku a jeho poslední výlet nekončí plánovanou sebevraždou. Slade si s Chrisovou pomocí začne znovu uvědomovat krásy života a pomalu se změní na energického muže, jakým kdysi býval. Mezi slepcem... a Chrisem postupně vzniká sympatie a důvěra. Slade pomůže chlapcovi vyřešit i jeho školní problémy. Vůně ženy je jednoznačně hereckým a mistrovským sólem Al Pacina. Za svůj výkon slepého důstojníka získal svého prvního Oscara /1993/ a Zlatý glóbus /1993/ za nejlepší mužský herecký výkon.

programme.title: Bračne vode
programme.desc: Nespokojený prodavač bot, jeho obtížná žena a jejich dvě nezvládnutelné dospívající děti řeší radosti a strasti běžného života na předměstí Chicaga. Al Bunda je celkem roztomilý chlapík. Má kousavou manželku Peggy, nadrženého syna Buda, hloupou ale krásnou dceru Kelly a začínající pleš. A taky prodává boty. Al Bunda alias Dr. Bota vám kdykoliv poradí, ať máte jakýkoliv problém s botami. Ale teď ho prosím nerušte, právě začíná jeho oblíbený televizní program Táta Cvok a tak si Al musí vyvrtět ten správný důlek na prosezeném gauči a elegantně zavěsit pravičku za spodky.

Na losangeleskou tísňovou linku volají denně desítky lidí, kteří se ocitli v nouzové situaci. Hasiči, policisté a operátoři musejí nejen pomáhat v těchto nebezpečných momentech, ale zároveň se potýkají s vlastními problémy v soukromí.

Na losangeleskou tísňovou linku volají denně desítky lidí, kteří se ocitli v nouzové situaci. Hasiči, policisté a operátoři musejí nejen pomáhat v těchto nebezpečných momentech, ale zároveň se potýkají s vlastními problémy v soukromí. Hasiči a záchranári v Los Angeles zasahujú v hraničných situáciách, v ktorých sa ľuďom vracajú dôsledky ich bývalých činov. Muža zabije guľka odrazená od stromu, do ktorého náhodne vystrelila jeho týraná manželka. Hasič Bobby daruje krv, ale po analýze vzoriek mu okamžite volajú z nemocnice. Bobby sa bojí, že smrteľne ochorel a už nestihne odčiniť náhodné zabitie svojej rodiny, ktorá zomrela v plameňoch, keď v opitosti podpálil byt. Trest si už odsedel, ale chce ešte zachrániť rovnaký počet... ľudských životov, aký zmaril svojím konaním v minulosti. Po rozhovore s deťmi sa Athena rozhodne pre rozvod. Abby a Buck sa intímne zblížia a posunú svoj vzťah na vyššiu úroveň. Na tiesňovú linku v Los Angeles denne volajú desiatky ľudí, ktorí sa ocitli v núdzovej situácii. Hasiči, policajti, záchranári a dispečeri zasahujú nielen v týchto nebezpečných situáciách, ale zároveň bojujú s vlastnými problémami a v súkromí pomáhajú svojim rodinám, známym a blízkym.

programme.title: Uvod u anatomiju
programme.desc: Seznamte se. To je Meredith Greyová (Ellen Pompeo) - mladá, úspěšná, krásná dívka. Před nedávnem dokončila medicínu a nyní nastupuje jako začínající stážistka v Seattle Grace. Spolu se svými kamarády (Cristina, Alex,Izzie, George) překonává problémy, které ji začínající kariéra přináší a my sledujeme jejich boj o "přežití". Dramatický, vtipný, příjemný - přesně taková slova se hodí na seriál Chirurgové. Seriál získal dva Zlaté Glóby a v USA boří rekordy ve sledovanosti.

programme.title: Gola istina
programme.desc: Úspěšná televizní producentka Abby je velmi romantická a stále hledá svou životní lásku. Čeká ji však drsný návrat do reality, když ji její šéfové přinutí spolupracovat se samolibým odborníkem na vztahy Mikem. Zpočátku je jeho skepsí a pokřiveným pohledem na lásku pobouřená, vzápětí ale zjistí, že jeho rady fungují.. Abby je ambiciózní producentka ranní televizní talk show, která je hrdá na to, že dokáže během chvilky vyřešit jakýkoliv problém. Tedy kromě toho, že je stále svobodná. Když jejímu pořadu začne klesat sledovanost, je nucena přijmout do týmu Mika Chadwaye, šovinistickou, drzou televizní hvězdu. Jeho pořad Chceš mě, chci tě by měl diváky seznamovat s tím, jak muži doopravdy fungují. Producentka jeho styl nesnáší, ale pořad se pochopitelně okamžitě stane hitem. Pak se Abby potká s Colinem, svým... sousedem, který je svobodný a pracuje jako lékař. Je přesně takový, jaký Mike není, šarmantní a zdv ořilý. Protože to Abby tentokrát nechce pokazit, požádá Mika o radu. A čeká ji velké překvapení, jeho metody fungují. Může ale vydržet vztah založený na přetvářce, nebo ji čeká další zklamání.

programme.title: Vampirski dnevnici
programme.desc: Caroline, Matt, Jeremy and Bonnie party at a bar as Elena dances on the bar and strips to a tank top when Matt shouts at her to take it off. Someone hands her a shot and as she's about to down it, she stops and hops down, confronting her friends, not able to believe that they can't tell she's not herself. The real Elena would never dance on a bar and do shots with her underage brother, she tells them, explaining that she's not herself -- she's Katherine.Elena wakes up in her dorm room. The... whole house is empty. She's goes downstairs and finds Stefan there. He tells her everyone's gone on s pring break and she's been in an out. They sealed her in with a spell.The last thing she remembers is running through the woods, feeling like she was being attacked by Katherine's whole life, then throwing her arms around Damon. That was three weeks ago.She knows Katherine infected her with the Augustine virus. Bonnie's new witch friend Liv sealed Elena in. Caroline is out looking for an antidote and they're rationing blood to keep her satiated. She wants to talk to Damon.But he's currently locked up in his cellar. Jeremy and Matt bring him vampire blood. Elena doesn't know Damon killed Aaron Whitmore, and Damon insists he be the one to tell her. Elena calls and they bring Damon his phone.She's calling from a payphone because Katherine put a passcode on her phone and she can't use it. She's freaked out by not knowing what happened the last three weeks. She asks him how Katherine broke his heart. He shrugs it off like he doesn't remember."The last thing I remember I was running into your arms and I felt so safe," she says. "It was all downhill from there," he says. "I wanted to fight for you, I still do.""The second we are cured of this and don't want to rip each other's heads off, I am going to hunt you down and give you the most mind-blowing night of your life," Damon says.Meanwhile, in Wes Maxfield's lab, Caroline finds Wes's recorder and hears him saying that he added the werewolf venom to the virus to make it even stronger.Enzo strolls in. Caroline isn't happy to see bad Damon's killing buddy, but he tells her he has the antidote.On the phone, Elena realizes she's probably flunking her classes, and adds that to the list of things she needs to fix, including talking to Aaron Whitmore. The last time she saw him he had just learned she was a vampire and thought she wanted to kill him. Damon hems and haws and doesn't confess to killing him, only saying he doesn't think she'll find him.Elena gets off the phone when Stefan arrives with a new cell phone for her, and 4 oz. of his blood. She's woozy and starving and drains it. She asks for more, insisting she's fine.Stefan bites his wrist and shows it to her and she quickly loses control and charges him, but is trapped by the spell. "You're not fine, Elena," he says.Elena realizes Katherine has turned her into a ripper. She's angry at herself for forgiving Katherine on her supposed death bed.Caroline calls with an update: werewolf venom in the virus means it's fatal. But she says she has antidote if Stefan will go meet her. The Travelers don't want Liv the new witch to know about it, so he has to go to her.Elena asks Stefan why Katherine stayed in town, and he confesses that Katherine was trying to get with him. He tells Elena they kissed, but he stopped it and realized what was going on.At the bar, Liv is jazzed about being able to seal Elena in. Bonnie tries to get her to stop bragging then challenges her to a fire spell, but she can't do it.With her new phone, Elena leaves Aaron a message. Then she reads Katherine's entries in her diary, including her ploy to get near Stefan.Elena "remembers" Katherine spilling oil on her and stripping in front of Stefan and coming on to him. He starts kissing him passionately then pulls away, asking why he can't tell she's not herself. After everything they've been through, she wouldn't lead him on like that. Elena goes to leave and Damon is at the motel room door. He mocks Stefan for falling for the grease-on-my-shirt ploy. Elena tells them both to stop and tells them that even dead, Katherine is ruining their lives. "You think this is bad? You have no idea, do you?" Stefan says.Back reading the diary, Elena's nose starts bleeding.Enzo leads Stefan and Caroline to an abandoned rail yard to meet with Sloane and the Travelers -- Stefan already met some of them when they took a bucket of his blood. Enzo tells them how he was trapped in a farm house with ripper Damon when Wes and the Travelers let him go on the condition he help them.Wes needed a vampire to experiment on, so Enzo let him in order to make an antidote. The Travelers are using Wes's work to make an antidote to the version Elena has because she's valuable to them. But they need something. "Another one of you," Sloane tells Stefan.Elena talks to Damon and asks him to distract her. Damon tells her about Caroline and Klaus and that Katherine told Tyler.Elena gets a coughing fit and coughs up blood.Elena asks why they don't just hunt down Wes for the antidote and Damon tells her he killed Wes. She points out Wes was the only family that Aaron has, but then Damon is spared telling her he killed Aaron when Matt comes in for Damon's feeding.Enzo explains that the Travelers think the last remaining dopplegangers -- Stefan and Elena- are special. But until Stefan's other doppelganger is found, his blood mixed with Elena's won't do anything. Stefan reminds them the last time a witch (Amara) linked him to his doppelganger, she fried his brain and he lost his memory.Alone in her dorm, Elena gets woozy and starts hallucinating again. She sees Aaron Whitmore and sees that his room is empty. Then she sees his bloody neck. "Are you dead? Did I do this to you?" she says.Elena is snapped out of her hallucination when a guy named Luke comes back early from spring break. She met him at the Bitter Ball as Katherine, but of course doesn't remember him. He thinks she's drunk. She tells him she's just starving. She compels him, feeds him her blood and is about to kill him to turn him when she notices bite marks on his neck and realizes Katherine must have been feeding on him. She stops and compels him to go get Bonnie.Elena calls Damon in a panic, she can't tell what's real anymore. She tells Damon she thinks she killed Aaron. Damon promises to tell her everything, but says now isn't a good time. She freaks out, yelling that everyone is lying to her. She throws the phone. Damon yells for Matt, asking him to charge his phone.Instead, he grabs Matt, yanks off his ring and calls in Jeremy -- demanding to see Elena.Caroline and Stefan discuss the Traveler's plans. He agrees to be linked to his doppelganger. The Travelers give the antidotes to Enzo to deliver and Caroline stays with Stefan.Sloane slices Stefan's hand for the spell. The Travelers begin chanting and Stefan screams.Back in the dorm, Elena is losing her mind, she's ripping up books and throwing them on the fire. Bonnie and Liv arrive. Elena announces she's cleansing herself of everything Katherine ever touched.Bonnie tells her she's not herself, and Elena yells about that being ironic because she wasn't herself for weeks and nobody noticed. Bonnie tries to reason with her, that Katherine was trying to destroy her and this is what she wants. Elena pretends to be swayed, but grabs a piece of wood and throws it javelin-style at Liv, skewering her.She points out Liv will need her blood to survive, so she should drop the seal.Back at the rail yard, night has fallen and the Travelers are still chanting their spell. Finally, Sloane can see Stefan's doppelganger. He's a paramedic in Atlanta.Caroline urges them to stop, but Sloane wants more information, saying she needs the doppelganger dead. Caroline has had enough and puts a knife to Sloane's throat, telling her there's a way they can all get what they want.Elena wanders outside her dorm, still coughing up blood and hallucinating. She sees Aaron and thinks it means he's OK, but it's really Damon.Damon gives her Stefan's blood to drink."She won, Katherine won," Elena said. She rants about nearly killing Liv and killing Aaron Whitmore. Finally, Damon tells her she didn't kill Aaron -- he did.Damon tells her he killed Aaron the night he thought she broke up with him and to prove to himself that he was the type of person who could kill in cold blood and he was never going to change.He waits for her to say something, but she sees Enzo there -- with the antidotes.When Stefan wakes up from his Traveler mind probe Caroline tells him she and Enzo are going to Atlanta to kill his doppelganger, which she volunteered to do so they'd stop frying Stefan's brain. Stefan warns her not to trust Enzo.Bonnie walks Liv back to her dorm. Liv is not fazed by being attacked by Elena and is ready for more witch lessons.When Bonnie leaves, Liv walks into her room alone and lights all her candles easily with magic. Luke, who turns out to be her (gay) brother, is waiting for her.He faked being compelled by Elena. They know Bonnie is the anchor and are letting her think she's teaching Liv magic. Luke says it's only cute until she realizes her friends are in jeopardy.Elena finally talks to Damon, telling him he should have noticed she was Katherine. If he had, Aaron would still be alive, there'd be no virus. Damon points out she's blaming Katherine for his mistakes and making excuses for him.They start yelling, with her noting he's forcing her to compromise her morals again to make excuses for him. He calls their relationship toxic and they agree they shouldn't be together. He tells her to stop loving him, but she yells that she can't. She says it's over.That lasts for three seconds, and then they tear each other's clothes off and get in bed. Přátelé drží Elenu a Damona v izolaci. Hrozí, že by napadli buď sami sebe navzájem, nebo jiného upíra. Objeví se Enzo a ve spolupráci s poutníky nabídne Stefanovi a Caroline získání protijedu. Stefan a Caroline podstoupí rituální kouzlení za účelem nalezení Stefanova dvojníka výměnou za protijed. Bonnie netuší, že kouzelnice Liv společně se svým bratrem Lukem pracují proti upírům.

programme.title: Vampirski dnevnici
programme.desc: Sloane uses her Traveler mind meld to find Stefan's paramedic doppelganger Tom Avery at Atlanta Metropolitan Hospital. They see Tom refusing to wait for a doctor and performing a procedure to save a woman's life.Meanwhile, at casa de Salvatore, Elena wakes up in bed with Damon. Her phone buzzes to remind her to go to Jeremy's parent-teacher conference.When Damon wakes up, Elena says they're still bad for each other and still broken up and last night was a mistake."Maybe we should keep making... mistakes," Damon says. She leaves, despite his offer of a naked breakfast.At a diner in Atla nta, Enzo picks up Sloane's call to Caroline to give them more information. Back at Traveler HQ, they're carrying Stefan away on a stretcher. He's passes out. Caroline is angry that Sloane "dopplebombed" him again and threatens to kill her too if she does it again."Like a perky blonde Angel of Death, almost had me convinced," Enzo says.Damon heads to the Grill to drown his morning sorrow in booze. He complains to Tyler and Matt about Elena and mentions that Caroline is off doing something with Stefan, although he taunts Tyler by assuring him they're just friends.Liv, Bonnie's training witch (but not really), walks over to the bar and buys a bottle of gin. After rebuffing Damon, he sees her sit down at a table with Jeremy.Meanwhile, Elena calls Bonnie from school. She tells her about breaking up with Damon, then sleeping with him. They realize that neither of them knows where Jeremy was last night.Elena sits down to talk to Jeremy's guidance counselor and finds she's not his primary contact -- Damon is. Damon joins them.At the hospital in Atlanta, Caroline is cool to Enzo. He finally asks if she's avoiding the mission or him. "Why can't it be both?" she asks.When she questions why he's along on the trip, he jokes with Damon trying to do right he needs a new "murder buddy."She makes sure she's not the reason he's there. "Why not? From what Damon tells me, I am your type. Well-traveled, charming accent, dodgy morals..." Ezno says. "Arrogant, tactless, completely unable to take a hint," Caroline finishes. "Precisely," Enzo says. Then he tells her she reminds him of Maggie, a woman who worked with the Augustines, and observed him.The doctor they've been waiting for joins them and tells them Tom Avery disappeared four months ago.Stefan wakes up and realizes the Travelers have moved him to a junk yard outside Mystic Falls. They're waiting to meet Markos.Caroline calls with news that Tom is MIA. Sloan starts back up with the Traveler mind meld and Caroline worries they're frying Stefan's brain.Stefan sees a red-haired woman named Hazel asking Tom out after he saved her friend's life. She gives him an address. Stefan tells Caroline that Tom is a good person and not to go through with it.Waiting for the teacher at school, Damon flirts with Elena, who tries to keep him on task. Damon mentions seeing Jeremy with Liv and a bottle of booze this morning at the Grill. Elena is sure Jeremy's not a cheater.Then the teacher comes in: "Jeremy's missed 11 days of school, he's started three fights and he's been caught cheating in math class twice."She tells them Jeremy needs a stable living situation.At Hazel's address, they open the door and find Hazel performing a spell. When they can't get in, Enzo throws the doorknob at her head, killing her.Bonnie studies at Whitmore and sees Lucas nearby, continually looking at her. Suddenly, Hazel appears. She recognizes Bonnie as the anchor and tells her to tell Lucas she failed in hiding the doppelganger.At the Grill, Liv uses a spell to keep Tyler from listening as she talks to Jeremy. As a hunter, he can't be mind-controlled by Travelers, so he's the only one she trusts. She tells him the Travelers are up to something and they're on their way to Mystic Falls."Turns out Elena's friends are right -- the world does revolve around her," Liv says. She wants his help figuring out what the Travelers are up to. Then she gets a text from Lucas about Hazel, calling for Plan B.She tells Jeremy never mind, he was Plan A. Tyler zooms over to get answers and she uses magic to fling him backward, also informing them she's not a newbie witch.At school, Damon points out that Elena is making excuses for Jeremy, just like she always does with people she loves. She thinks he wants to talk about last night. He admits he doesn't know what to say, but just wants to take her into one of the classrooms and kiss every square inch of her body while people who drive minivans listen and wish they were them. She's tempted.Back in Atlanta, Enzo tries to prepare Caroline for having to kill Tom. He doesn't think she's up for it. She's insisting she is to save Stefan when they both hear a beating heart.They find Tom Avery drugged on a stretcher in the basement. Caroline realizes four months ago was when Silas, "the original Stefan-ganger" died.Enzo offers to kill Tom for Caroline, but she insists on doing it her way. When Tom wakes up, she compels him to trust her. Then she snaps Enzo's neck and tells Tom she's getting him out of there.Back at Whitmore, Bonnie learns Lucas is Liv's twin brother and a witch. She's creeped out they were watching her.Jeremy calls Bonnie asking where Elena is. He briefly tells her what Liv said about Elena and the Travelers. When Bonnie gets off the phone, Lucas is gone.At school, Elena drags Damon into a classroom and starts to rip his clothes off. Then the chemistry teacher's droning snaps her out of her daydream. She gets up to get air.Liv finds Elena in shop class. She flings Elena against the wall and prepares to stake her. "Sorry about this, the coven did everything in its power to protect you, but you're just too dangerous now," Liv says.She's about to drive the stake home when Damon finds Liv and knocks her out.Meanwhile, at the diner in Atlanta, Tom Avery tells Caroline his life story. She wants to make sure he's as good as he seems. Then he starts choking. Caroline doesn't help, and moves his water away.Then she's snapped out her daydream and goes back to watching Tom eating hungrily for the first time in four months. She compels Tom to get on a train and start a new life somewhere.Back at the high school, Damon tortures Liv for information. Elena points out that things like this are the reason they broke up.Finally, Liv tells them that Elena is the last female doppelganger and that Stefan might soon be the last male and if that happens, the Travelers will come to use Elena.Damon is ready to kill Liv, but Jeremy shows up and says Damon will have to go through him.Out in the parking lot, Tyler and Matt confront Lucas. Tyler grabs him before he can use magic on them.In the shop, Jeremy tries to convince Elena and Damon that Liv will help them keep Elena safe. Elena questions his trustworthiness considering all the stuff he's been pulling in school. "How can you expect me to care about school when this is my life?" Jeremy asks.He tells them Liv knows more about the Travelers than she's letting on.Elena tells Damon to trust Jeremy. Outside, Liv yells at her brother for not coming to help her. Jeremy tells them both his Plan C is for them to protect Elena while he helps them stop the Travelers. But he needs help -- Matt and Tyler.Caroline walks Tom to his car when Enzo appears. Before Caroline can stop him, Enzo snaps Tom's neck. He also made a deal -- the Travelers told him they know where to find his old flame Maggie.Back at the Salvatore house, Elena tells Damon she thinks they're bad for Jeremy. Then Jeremy joins them, suitcase in hand. He's going to stay with Tyler and Matt.Caroline returns to the Traveler junk yard and tells Stefan she's a big fat failure. "You do realize you're feeling guilty for not being able to kill somebody?" Stefan says.She tells him Enzo killed Tom.Stefan teases her for being out all day flirting with yet another British man while he was having his brain fried. But he suggests they sleep, and then figure out how to get out of there together.Caroline realizes that Stefan knew she wouldn't kill Tom. "Because that's what makes you you," he says.At the Salvatore house, Elena packs to go back to campus. "It's not just that we're bad for each other, it's that when we're together we do bad things for each other and I can't live like that," Elena says.She declines his offer of a ride, saying she needs him to let her go. He kisses her on the forehead and wishes her safe travels.Bonnie leaves Jeremy a message wanting to know what's going on. Stefan and Caroline wake up spooning in a car in the junkyard, hearing Traveler chanting.They see the Travelers drinking his blood and Elena's and chanting about Markos. Sloane takes a torch and lights a Traveler on fire and they all burst into flame.Stefan takes Caroline's hand and they run.At Whitmore, the dead Travelers appear around Bonnie chanting and pass through her one at a time, making her scream in pain. She passes out. Then a spirit of a man rises from her and walks away. Caroline a Enzo hledají v Atlantě pro poutníky Stefanova dvojníka, Toma, jak po nich chtěla výměnou za Stefanův život vůdce poutníků Sloan. Čarodějka Liv se pokusí zaútočit na Elenu a zabít ji. Naštěstí zasáhne Damon a Elenu ochrání. Liv se přizná, že to dělá proto, že čarodějky nechtějí, aby se Eleny zmocnili poutníci. Jeremy slíbí, že tomu zabrání. Caroline a Enzo Toma najdou, ale Caroline není schopná Toma zabít, a dokonce se ho pokusí ochránit. Tomu zabrání ale Enzo. Enzo Toma zabije ve... chvilce, kdy to Elena nečeká. Caroline se vrací ke Stefanovi do ležení poutníků. Ti se následně před jejich očima upálí. Ve chvíli, kdy mrtví poutníci procházejí přes Bonnie do záhrobí, z jejího těla vyjde tajemná postava.

programme.title: Tijelo je dokaz
programme.desc: V den své svatby, krátce před samotným obřadem, se pádem z hotelového balkonu zabije nevěsta Melissa Waxmanová. Případ je vyšetřován jako možná sebevražda. Mladá žena totiž dlouhodobě nebyla spokojena se svým vzhledem a nedávno podstoupila řadu plastických operací. Kromě toho prodělala též operaci štítné žlázy a kvůli nevyrovnaným hladinám hormonů trpěla depresemi. Drobný nález na pitevním stole však potvrdí podezření detektiva Morrise, že nevěsta nezemřela dobrovolně.

programme.title: Vampirski dnevnici
programme.desc: Elena tries writing in her journal, but ends up ripping out the pages. They blow away in the breeze and Stefan picks them up.She tells him it's a particularly mortifying page from her journal. He hands it over. She introduces herself. He's nearly hit by a car, then she wakes up.Over a game of pool, Enzo tries to understand how things are going with Damon and Elena. Damon turns things around on Enzo and asks about his missing girlfriend, Maggie, who the Travelers were supposed to help... him find before they all ignited.Out for coffee with Caroline, Elena hallucinates an early date with Stefan, him bringing her home (to a different house) -- with her dad waiting up for her.Caroline snaps her back to reality and Elena realizes she has no memory of walking to the table. Elena tells Caroline the dream was like an alternate reality.Stefan calls Caroline, needing her to tell him he's not crazy. He describes having a vision of Elena and nearly getting hit by a car. Something's going on.At Whitmore, Bonnie leaves Jeremy yet another message. Then she gets a visit from her ghost Gram, who tells her something is wrong on the other side. The witches think the Travelers tried to overwhelm Bonnie so they could get someone through from the Other Side. Whoever he is has the witches scared.Liv prepares for Traveler war by briefing Matt and Tyler, but first she wants them to stab themselves with the knife to make sure they're not carrying a passenger. Tyler goes first and heals. Matt takes it in the shoulder and Liv gets back to the briefing.Her coven has been tracking the Travelers for thousands of years and they only stop moving once in a rare while, to take over a town with passengers, like they're doing now in Mystic Falls.We see Travelers approaching three people in Mystic Falls and transferring passengers to them -- including Sheriff Liz Forbes.Damon gets a call from Elena, but ignores it. Caroline wonders why her mom hasn't shown up and isn't answering her texts. Then she calls Enzo and gets him to put Damon on."You know how we all laughed off the notion that the universe was drawing Stefan and Elena together? Well, that's happening," Caroline says.With Tom dead, they're the last pair of dopplegangers. Damon tells them to bring a witch over so they can figure out what's going on.Bonnie shows up at Tyler's house to find Jeremy. She tells him about the visit from her Grams. She's angry to see Liv there, and Jeremy won't tell her what they're up to. He just assures her he has it handled and asks her to trust him.Matt visits Liz Forbes' office and calls Tyler, telling him the Travelers might have started with her. Passenger Liz hears him tell Tyler to bring the Traveler knife.He tries to lie to cover but she walks over and stabs him in the neck with a pen, killing him.Suddenly, Bonnie sees him standing on the street in front of her. He tells her he's dead and she should tell Jeremy the sheriff is in trouble. He passes through her to the other side, where he's surprised that the other people there can see him -- including Klaus's brother, Kol, who Jeremy killed.Kol explains the other side is unraveling. Matt is only there until his ring brings him back, and realizes he might be able to see Vicki.Caroline and Elena come by the Salvatore house and Enzo and Caroline quickly leave Elena and Damon alone to eavesdrop on the awkwardness as Elena asks if they can just be friends.Caroline asks about Maggie, and Enzo explains that she was his source of hope through 70 years of captivity. He doesn't want to date her, he wants to thank her.Damon asks Elena about the visions and then grits his teeth as he asks if the visions show her with Stefan and really, really happy.Luke, Liv's witch brother, shows up at the Salvatore house.Tyler approaches Liz on the street. She seems totally normal, but Tyler tests her by telling her his (dead) mom says hi. Passenger Liz tells him to say hi for her, so he stabs her with the Traveler knife. He's tending to her on the street when someone walks up to him.Back at the Salvatore house, Luke tells them their theory that Markos, the Traveler leader, is back. "Perfect. A dead old guy with a mysterious evil plan," Elena says.Luke suggests the visions are the Travelers drawing Stefan and Elena to them, but they need more clues.Later that night, Damon drinks outside, "listening to the universe laugh at me," he tells Elena. "We were doomed from the beginning, Elena. We were always going to end up here."She assures him the universe doesn't control anything and it's not real.In another vision of the future, Elena comes home to Stefan cooking dinner. She opens the drawers looking for a wine opener and finds a ring box instead. She says yes without him needing to ask.She sees a letter with the house address on it on Walnut Drive.She comes to and announces she knows where to find Markos.On the Other Side, Matt wanders around looking for Vicki and finds her. She tells him something is wrong and he needs to find his body and go back. They start running as the wind whips at them. She gets dragged backwards out of his grasp and he has to let her go. She sucked backwards up into a hole in the sky.Enzo and Damon approach the house on Walnut Drive. They find Markos inside. He tells them he's the reason Stefan and Elena are having visions of each other.He tells them the doppelganger lore has been misinterpreted over the years. They're being drawn together because of a spell he cast 1,500 years ago because the Travelers needed their blood. "It turns out the best way to get people to go searching for each other is the promise of true love," he says.Markos asks Damon to take a walk with him, telling Enzo to stay put if he wants info on Maggie.As they stroll, Markos explains (oh good, more lore!): 2,000 years ago Silas and Qetsia cast the spell for immortality, creating a schism in the Traveler community and giving rise to the witches, who tried to keep the Travelers scattered because they're more powerful together. The witches put a curse on them that kept them from settling down together as a tribe. Doppleganger blood can fix it.He tells Damon they don't want to hurt him and he'll end the visions. Dozens of Passengers in the square start chanting.In another Elena vision, she and Stefan have a pleasant family morning with two little rugrats running around. As the Travelers chant, Elena sees everything around her disappear.She comes out of it crying. Stefan is there, really. They both felt it just end. They weren't vampires, her family was still alive -- it was a fantasy they could never have. But it felt amazing to both of them.Stefan says the life they really had was amazing, too, and it was real, even when they grew apart. Stefan says he'll always love her, and she says the same. Elena wonders if she'll ever be able to talk to Damon like this. "I think you can either be friends with someone or in love with them," Stefan says.Back on the Other Side, Kol urges Matt to remember what's going on there and find a way to stop it.In Liz's office, Bonnie and Jeremy make up as she scolds him for not being honest with her, again. Matt comes back to life and remembers what he saw on the Other Side.Elena tells Damon about the perfect life she saw in her visions, even though he doesn't want to hear about it. She tells him it wasn't real and what they had was, but he tells her he can't be her friend. He doesn't want to see her again.Caroline sits over her mother's bed, waiting for her to wake up. She talks to Tyler on the phone. Liz wakes up and Tyler hangs up.He walks in the other room to talk to Markos -- he's passenger Tyler now. He brings Markos the last remaining Traveler knife, and he burns it in the fire. Elena a Stefan mají neustále představy o svém společném životě. Zatím poutníci začínají ovládat všechny lidi ve městě. Šerifka probodne Matta a pošle ho tak do říše mrtvých. Matt se zde setkává se svou dávno mrtvou láskou, Sheilou, a mrtvým upírem Kolem. Oba ho prosí, aby se vrátil do světa živých a něco provedl, a tím zastavil rozpad světa mrtvých. Díky Eleniným vizím se Damon a Enzo setkávají s vůdcem poutníků, Markosem. Ten Damona žádá o pomoc a výměnou zařídí, aby Elena a Stefan přestali... mít o sobě navzájem společné vize. Tyler není Tylerem, ale v Tylerově těle je nějaký Markosův pomoc ník. On a Markos plánují ovládnutí Mystic Falls. Katherine je následně vichřicí odnesena z kostela.

programme.title: Vampirski dnevnici
programme.desc: At Whitmore, Stefan helps Elena study and distracts her from Damon saying he can't be around her. Bonnie joins them to study, accepting the fact that if the Other Side disintegrates it means she'll die.Damon is back in Mystic Falls, working on the Traveler problem. He drops in on Matt and Jeremy at Tyler's house -- they can't find the Traveler knife and haven't heard from Tyler.Tyler wakes up, changed to a post. Markos summons his passenger, Julian. Markos addresses his people, riling them... up to break the witches' curse that prevents them from settling together. Sloane has volunteered to b e the guinea pig -- she drinks Tyler's blood and, after she says she's ready, Markos slits her throat.Damon calls Enzo, wanting to go searching for Tyler. But Enzo is going to meet some people.Bonnie lurks around Liv to solicit her help with the Other Sideimplosion. Enzo joins them and Elena and Stefan.He tells them about Maggie, who he last saw in 1950. Sloane gave him something from the Augstine files left behind by Dr. Wes. Maggie died in 1960 in Mystic Falls -- someone tore her head off. Stefan says he wasn't a ripper then.Enzo calls on Liv, who incapacitates Stefan and Elena with magic. Enzo reveals that he compelled some brutes to keep Liv's brother Luke hostage so Liv will do his bidding. Enzo wants answers about the death of the love of his life.Enzo takes over the café and compels everyone to ignore his interrogation of Elena and Stefan, as he ties them to chairs with vervane ropes.Stefan insists he wasn't ripping in 1960. Enzo catches Bonnie trying to alert Damon. Enzo asks Damon to check Stefan's journals from the day Maggie died in 1960. Damon tells him Stefan burned them all. Enzo mentions what he's up to and Damon is concerned, but also says Stefan wasn't ripping then.It was election night.Flash back to 1960 A figure in a trench coat follows a woman down an alley. Stefan attacks her, then stops and compels her to forget and run. Another woman walks up and recognizes him as a vampire -- it's Maggie. She says she's spent the last two years searching for Damon because he knew a friend of hers who died in a fire (Enzo). She's looking for Damon to kill him. Stefan vamps out.Back in the present, Stefan insists he didn't kill her. Then Enzo takes Bonnie hostage and Stefan says he actually did kill Maggie and just forgot about it until now. Enzo drives a stake into Stefan's stomach.Liv takes Bonnie upstairs, where Bonnie tells her to quit acting like a puppet. If either Stefan or Elena dies, the Travelers can't undo the witches spell and Liv wins.Damon leaves a message for Caroline while meeting with her mother to get the report on Maggie's death. Damon looks at the crime scene photos and recognizes it. "Stefan was right, he didn't kill Enzo's girl...because I did," Damon says.In the past, Maggie urges Enzo to turn her into a vampire so they can run away together. He bites himself and offers her his wrist, but then takes her vervane bracelet off. He compels her to forget he loves her and run far away.Back in torture café upstairs, Bonnie asks Liv about a way to stop the disintegration of the Other Side.Downstairs, Damon joins the fun. He tells Enzo that on that night in 1960, he got a message at the house that a woman wanted to interview him. He didn't know she was Enzo's Maggie.Back in 1960, she asks about the fire. As they're chatting, she takes out a needle and tries to inject him, but Damon gets her around the throat and rips her head off, thinking she's Augustine.Damon made it look like Stefan did it from his grudge of Stefan not coming to get him the five years he was in Augustine captivity.In the present, Damon explains his humanity switch was flipped. He tries to convince Enzo to take it out on him."I don't want to hate you. If I hate you, I have nothing left," Enzo says. He remembers compelling Maggie to leave him and Damon explaining how he switched off his humanity to leave Enzo in the fire.Enzo switches off his humanity.Back in the Traveler lair, Sloane comes back to life during her vampire transition. Markos recaps that vampirism comes from witch magic and the prophesy says doppelganger blood will undo witch magic. He feeds Sloan the doppelganger blood.Enzo enjoys his lack of humanity, drinks up at the bar. Damon suggests Enzo leave with him and slips Stefan a shard of glass to free himself.Enzo chomps down on Liv, Damon rushes Enzo and gets a broken off glass bottle to the neck. Stefan breaks free and pulls Enzo off, but Enzo gets free and grabs Elena and runs.Stefans stays to feed his blood to mortally wounded Liv and Damon goes after Elena, after Stefan reminds him that Enzo is beyond saving.Damon leaves Enzo a message asking him not to killelena.Elena tries to talk to Enzo as he drags her across campus. She breaks off a campus sign and attacks him, but with her hands still bound, he knocks her back. Stefan finds them.Stefan and Enzo beat each other up across parked cars in the pouring rain.Back at the café, Liv has healed and heard that Luke is OK. Liv tells Bonnie there's nothing to do she can do to save the Other Side and she should say good-bye.Damon finds Elena passed out on the grass. He takes off her vervane ropes and carries her away as Enzo beats up on Stefan.Enzo punches a whole in a car's gas tank and lets the fuel spill all over Stefan as he reaches for Maggie's lighter. Stefan reaches in Enzo's chest and squeezes his heart, telling him his can't be redeemed with his emotions off.Enzo realizes how much fun it will be for Stefan to have to explain to Damon that he killed his only friend. With Stefan still holding onto his heart inside his chest, Enzo pushes off Stefan, effectively yanking his heart from his chest.Damon brings Elena back to her room, then sees a text from Enzo making plans to meet to travel. Damon leaves before Elena wakes up.Later, Stefan checks on Elena in her room. He tells her Enzo's dead and he killed him. He tells her that Damon thinks Enzo left town and knowing otherwise would destroy him.Bonnie visits Jeremy at Tyler's house. She glosses over the risk with te Other Side collapsing. Stefan calls to warn her that Enzo is about to come through. He appears and reminds Bonnie how good he is at revenge.Back with the Travelers, Sloane announces that she's not a vampire anymore. Then she drops dead. Without the magic of vampirism to keep her alive, she revert to her (dead) human form, as will happen with all vampires in Mystic Falls. "Except we're going to need a lot more blood," Markos says.Stefan comes home to Damon, who thinks Enzo is his problem to solve.Stefan tells Damon that what happened with Enzo wasn't his fault. Damon talks about how Enzo kept him sane in captivity, reminding him he was lucky to have any family at all. Every time Damon wanted to give up, Enzo urged him not to lose faith in his family.Enzo's ghost watches over the brothers as they share a drink. "It's too late to make amends, Damon. You know me, never let go of a good vendetta. And this one is just getting started," Enzo says. Bonnie se od Liv dozvídá, že pokud se druhá strana rozpadne, zemře i ona, protože spojuje oba světy. Matt s Jeremym zoufale hledají dýku poutníků. Netuší, že ji ukradl falešný Tyler. Skutečný Tyler je zatím uvězněn ve skladišti, kde se poutníci zatím usadili. Markos zde dělá pokusy s krví Stefana a Eleny. Když svou pomocnici Sloan změní v člověka, dává příkaz získat víc dvojnické krve. Enzo zjistí, že jeho lásku Maggie kdysi zabil nějaký upír. Ve školní knihovně tedy uvězní Elenu se Stefanem... a mučením nutí Stefana k přiznání. Pomáhá mu v tom čarodějka Liv, které unesl bratra Luka. K vraždě se ale nakonec přizná Damon. Enzo se mu chce pomstít, a tak unese Elenu s tím, že ji z pomsty k Damonovi zabije. Jenže ho dohoní Stefan, Elenu osvobodí a Enza v souboji zabije. Stefan to ale Damonovi nechce říct.

programme.title: Gola istina
programme.desc: Úspěšná televizní producentka Abby je velmi romantická a stále hledá svou životní lásku. Čeká ji však drsný návrat do reality, když ji její šéfové přinutí spolupracovat se samolibým odborníkem na vztahy Mikem. Zpočátku je jeho skepsí a pokřiveným pohledem na lásku pobouřená, vzápětí ale zjistí, že jeho rady fungují.. Abby je ambiciózní producentka ranní televizní talk show, která je hrdá na to, že dokáže během chvilky vyřešit jakýkoliv problém. Tedy kromě toho, že je stále svobodná. Když jejímu pořadu začne klesat sledovanost, je nucena přijmout do týmu Mika Chadwaye, šovinistickou, drzou televizní hvězdu. Jeho pořad Chceš mě, chci tě by měl diváky seznamovat s tím, jak muži doopravdy fungují. Producentka jeho styl nesnáší, ale pořad se pochopitelně okamžitě stane hitem. Pak se Abby potká s Colinem, svým... sousedem, který je svobodný a pracuje jako lékař. Je přesně takový, jaký Mike není, šarmantní a zdv ořilý. Protože to Abby tentokrát nechce pokazit, požádá Mika o radu. A čeká ji velké překvapení, jeho metody fungují. Může ale vydržet vztah založený na přetvářce, nebo ji čeká další zklamání.

Na losangeleskou tísňovou linku volají denně desítky lidí, kteří se ocitli v nouzové situaci. Hasiči, policisté a operátoři musejí nejen pomáhat v těchto nebezpečných momentech, ale zároveň se potýkají s vlastními problémy v soukromí. Záchranári musia vyslobodiť bezdomovca spiaceho v kontajneri smetiarskeho auta. Potom zachraňujú matku so synom, ktorí ostali uväznení v pokazenom výťahu zaliatom vodou. Pri ľúbostnej hre sa Athena s milencom pripútajú k posteli tak nešťastne, že nedosiahnu na kľúče a musia zavolať kolegov záchranárov, aby ich vyslobodili. Bobbyho tím vyráža zachraňovať dvoch bratov, ktorí sú uväznení vo vlastnom dome. Jeden z nich je slepý a druhý vychádza von len zriedkavo. Ich dom je plný haraburdia a... nemožno sa v ňom hýbať. Chimney sa musí prebojovať odpadkami a obísť pripravené pasce, ktoré bratia nac hystali na zlodejov. Losangeleskí záchranári sa musia vyrovnávať s neustálym stresom v práci a problémami v súkromí. Na tiesňovú linku v Los Angeles denne volajú desiatky ľudí, ktorí sa ocitli v núdzovej situácii. Hasiči, policajti, záchranári a dispečeri zasahujú nielen v týchto nebezpečných situáciách, ale zároveň bojujú s vlastnými problémami a v súkromí pomáhajú svojim rodinám, známym a blízkym. Okrem toho, že títo moderní hrdinovia každý deň zachraňujú životy cudzích a neznámych ľudí, musia si nájsť čas aj na riešenie svojich vlastných osobných problémov, od ktorých neustále odbiehajú, aby pomáhali druhým.
